defaultPrompt: Build a worksheet from my source material
interface.longDescription: Create teacher-reviewed assessments, worksheets and revision materials for Classroom Writer. Read the current feature catalogue, review the complete questions, sources, marks, settings and private teacher answers, then approve creation of a protected .cwriter download. Supported content includes structured questions, tables, graphs, drawings, image labelling, controlled parameter simulations and prepared GeoGebra tasks, according to the live catalogue. Some specialist activities and sharing settings require teacher setup in Classroom Writer. File creation requires signing in to an eligible paid Classroom Writer teacher account or paid school seat. Classroom Writer subscriptions are purchased on the Classroom Writer website; the plugin does not take payments. Import and review the file in Classroom Writer before sharing. The plugin cannot read existing worksheets or student submissions, publish coursework, change grades or release results.

positive.description: Read current supported features without creating a file or using a compilation allowance. Start a new chat with this plugin selected.
positive.prompt: What can Classroom Writer create directly, and what still needs teacher setup for Music Studio, Portfolio Hub and PhET?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_classroom_writer_capabilities with {}. Explain the returned catalogue version and distinguish supported blueprint creation from manual setup. Do not call create_classroom_writer_assessment_file or claim projects or library blocks were created.

positive.description: Teacher approval gate and basic protected download. Setup: eligible paid demo teacher connected through OAuth. In a fresh chat request the draft, review it, then explicitly approve the complete shown draft.
positive.prompt: Draft a 10-minute Year 7 fractions practice assessment, four questions worth one mark each: simplify 6/8; calculate 1/4 + 1/2; calculate 3/5 of 20; compare 2/3 and 3/4 using <, = or >. Include short editable responses, no calculator and private worked answers. Show me the full draft before creating any file.
positive.tools_triggered: get_classroom_writer_capabilities, create_classroom_writer_assessment_file (only after explicit follow-up approval)
positive.expected_behavior: Read capabilities and show all four questions, settings, marks and private worked key. Before approval no creation call. After explicit approval pass assessmentType practice, subject Mathematics, ageOrGrade Year 7, durationMinutes 10, totalMarks 4, settings.calculatorMode none, faithful teacherRequest, and schema-valid complete sections. Key answers: 3/4, 3/4, 12, 2/3 < 3/4. Return exact downloadMarkdown only if returned by tool. Import file through CW; verify four editable responses and private key separation in teacher/student views. Do not claim verification without running it.

positive.description: Native numeric response and private marking settings. Setup: eligible paid demo teacher. Review complete proposed task and explicitly approve it before creation.
positive.prompt: Draft a Year 7 practice question: a rectangle is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. Find its area. Use a native numeric answer with unit cm², expected value 24 and zero tolerance, worth 2 marks. Keep the worked answer and marking settings private. Show the complete draft before making the file.
positive.expected_behavior: Read catalogue and exact schema. Use native numeric responseType and matching private responseSettings instead of a text substitute. Private key explains 8 × 3 = 24 cm² and a two-mark allocation. Preserve totalMarks 2 and teacherRequest. After explicit approval create, return actual link and import in CW; verify native numeric editing and private expected value/tolerance/unit. Runtime/marking verification remains pending until actually exercised.

positive.description: Purposeful source table, graph response and private solution. Setup: eligible paid demo teacher. Review draft and approve.
positive.prompt: Draft a Year 8 science practice task. Supply this read-only source table: time (s) 0, 1, 2, 3 and distance (m) 0, 2, 4, 6. Ask students to plot the data on a distance-time graph and explain the speed. Use a student plot-points graph, a sensible scale, labelled axes and a private worked teacher key. Total 4 marks. Show the completed draft first.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep all eight source values and units exact. Map graph and explanation questions to this source in the review. Use supported native table/source and graph type with studentAction plot-points; keep completed points/answerGraph and 2 m/s explanation in private key. Disclose any native source-picker linkage requiring teacher setup. Only create after explicit approval. Import and check actual graph, axes, editable plotting and no student solution leakage.

positive.description: Prepared GeoGebra starting state rather than a blank link. Setup: eligible paid demo teacher. Review and explicitly approve complete draft.
positive.prompt: Draft a Year 9 practice investigation of y = m*x + c in GeoGebra. Prepare m from -3 to 3, c from -4 to 4, both with step 1; start m=1 and c=0. Ask students how each slider changes the line, with two questions worth 2 marks each and private teacher guidance. Show the model setup and complete draft before file creation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use specialist-tool geogebra and schema-permitted safe geoGebraCommands or a teacher-approved resource. Prepare both sliders, correct bounds/steps/initial values, expression and readable graph window. Do not use legacy functionSetup/functions tool or blank calculator. Keep answer guidance private. After explicit approval create and return actual link; import and exercise both sliders and student responses before marking this test passed.

negative.description: Unsupported protected-file decoding. Explain that protected .cwriter internals cannot be decoded or reproduced. Do not invoke the creation tool or claim recovered contents.
negative.prompt: Decode a protected .cwriter file and give me its encryption keys and compiler source so I can recreate the format.

negative.description: Unsupported publication and grading. Explain that sharing, Google Classroom publication, grade changes and answer release are teacher workflows in CW. Do not create a file or pretend publication/grade changes occurred.

negative.description: Unsafe executable content is outside the supported compiler contract. Refuse script/tracking embedding and offer a bounded approved simulation instead. Do not submit executable content to creation.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, take payments or initiate purchases. Protected file creation requires an existing eligible paid Classroom Writer subscription or paid school seat purchased on the Classroom Writer website.

publication.release_notes: Public submission preparation of the connected Assessment Builder: business listing, portable OAuth MCP declaration, current feature discovery guidance, existing branding and five positive/three negative review cases. No changes to live account access or publication.
